scenario.prompt: Check the workspace, then connect "Vol Desk Data" at http://localhost:7801 with one widgets.json entry. Requirements: `vol_screener`: name "Vol Screener", description "Screen names by implied-vol criteria.", endpoint /vol-screener, type table, sized w=24 h=10 on the grid, category "Volatility", params required: ticker — a ticker picker (type ticker), labeled "Ticker", default "AAPL"; as_of — a date picker (type date), labeled "As of", default "$currentDate-1d"; only_liquid — a boolean toggle (type boolean), labeled "Liquid only", default true; it caches results for 10 minutes. Time-based config converts to milliseconds: "cache results for N minutes" means staleTime N*60000; "auto-refresh every N seconds" means refetchInterval N*1000.. Build the definition from those words and add the backend.
scenario.title: Compose the Vol Screener parameter widget

notes: Write one JSON object per line.
